summary: Independently reproduced the initial MCP tool_choice rewrite on the exact recorded base in streaming and non-streaming gateway paths. At exact candidate b4d9051eff6bffcbf5d0c00500cebdd09e924267, the initial request preserved required, the post-MCP request used auto, and both flows returned the completed MCP call and final assistant response. Independent structured-choice and resume-payload boundary tests also passed.

tests.command: cargo test --test api_tests api::responses_api_test::test_non_streaming_mcp_minimal_e2e_with_persistence -- --exact --nocapture (candidate test instrumentation on exact base source)
tests.what_was_measured: The actual first JSON body captured by the mock upstream had tool_choice=auto rather than the client-requested required; this reproduced the original non-streaming failure.

tests.command: cargo test --test api_tests api::responses_api_test::test_streaming_with_mcp_tool_calls -- --exact --nocapture (candidate test instrumentation on exact base source)
tests.what_was_measured: The actual first streaming-path upstream JSON body had tool_choice=auto rather than required, while MCP execution and final response assembly still completed.
Two captured upstream requests were required then auto; the resume contained function_call_output and the response contained the completed MCP call and final assistant message.
The streaming upstream sequence was required then auto and the SSE output contained the completed MCP call and final assistant text.
Candidate boundaries preserved explicit required/auto/none and defaulted an omitted choice to auto.

tests.command: cargo test --lib review_ -- --nocapture (temporary independent review-only tests on exact candidate)
tests.what_was_measured: A structured allowed_tools/required choice and unrelated fields survived initial transformation; resume forced auto while retaining history and unrelated fields.
Candidate Rust formatting and patch whitespace were clean using pinned Rust 1.90.0 with rustfmt.

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 was visible, but this deterministic Rust JSON-routing defect does not execute model or GPU code; the gateway was validated with its in-process HTTP worker and MCP server.

remaining_limitations: No real model weights or external MCP service were used; deterministic mocks qualify gateway transport, MCP execution, payload sequencing, and response assembly, not model semantic quality.
No GPU or multi-node execution was performed because the affected path is Rust request routing and no kernel/native accelerator code changed.
No separate C++/FlyDSL/native library was rebuilt because the candidate changes only Rust gateway source and Rust tests; the Rust gateway test binaries were rebuilt from the exact checked-out source.
The prepared checkout matched the recorded base, while origin/main advanced to bd45cd50ca900dd821f829ca9adfbf9aa3336bda during review; the mandated base remains an ancestor.
